text: Given the triad of a large ovarian mass, ascites, and pleural effusion, this presentation is highly suggestive of Meigs syndrome. To confirm this diagnosis and rule out malignancy, I will request imaging of the abdomen and pelvis. REQUEST IMAGES

text: Do you have any history of heart failure or liver disease that could explain the fluid accumulation? I need to rule out these causes before confirming Meigs syndrome.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying those symptoms. Since your CA-125 is normal and you lack signs of heart or liver failure, I am confident this is Meigs syndrome caused by a benign ovarian tumor. DIAGNOSIS READY: Meigs syndrome
